none: PAS NCL-36C8B2: NCL-36C8B2: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

An imperial lead sealing dating to late second to fourth century AD. The sealing is rectangular in plan and section. The sealing possesses a stamped rectangular die with the legend 'DN' in relief, translating as ' d(omini) n(ostri)' (Property) of Our Lord (the Emperor). The reverse is plain.
